title: Cyclotomic polynomials and homological criteria for mapping class types
summary: Let $S_g$ be a closed orientable surface and let $Ψ\colon \mathrm{Mod}(S_g)\to \mathrm{Sp}(2g,\mathbb{Z})$ be the representation induced by the action on first homology. We investigate the characteristic polynomials of integral symplectic matrices arising from mapping classes of algebraically finite type and give a complete characterization in the cyclotomic case: for $n\geq 3$, the polynomial $\varphi_n(x)$ is realized by a mapping class of algebraically finite type if and only if $n$ has at most two distinct prime divisors.
